SlideMate 0.4 lets you pick your tutor: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Grok, or a free model on your Mac.

### New
- **Gemini, through Google's Antigravity**: sign in with a Google account (the free plan works). Gemini, plus the
  Claude and GPT-OSS models your plan includes. It reads the slide image too.
- **Cursor**: your Cursor plan, with any model Cursor offers.
- **Grok**: your grok.com / SuperGrok account.
- **On this Mac, with Ollama**: a free model that runs offline. Answers are simpler, but nothing leaves your Mac.
  SlideMate suggests qwen3-vl:8b (about 6 GB), which can see slides; it's best with 16 GB of memory or more.
- **One-click setup for all of them**: each card on the setup screen has **Install & sign in** (or **Start Ollama…**),
  and SlideMate notices by itself when you're done.
- Pick a model for each from Settings → AI tutor or the chat box, and attach pictures in the chat with any of them.
- **Connections (MCP)** can be imported from Cursor, Grok and Antigravity as well.

### Install
Already on 0.3? SlideMate offers this update by itself (or choose SlideMate → **Check for Updates…**).

New here: download **SlideMate-0.4.0-macOS.zip** below, unzip it, and drag SlideMate into Applications. First open:
macOS 15+: System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**; macOS 13–14: right-click → **Open**. The app isn't
notarised yet.
